(module asl-syntax/tests/asl/layoutCorpusHelper
                                                                 
  :x [runShard]
  :i [(asl-syntax/asl/layout :a lay)
      (asl-parser/indentParser :a ip)
      (asl-parser/reader :a rd)])

fn isParenOrInvalidFile path: String -> Bool
  (cond
    ((stringContains? path "tests/fixtures/") true)
    ((stringContains? path "asl/grammar/corpus/") true)
    ((stringContains? path "closureParity/") true)
    ((stringContains? path "scratch/") true)
    ((stringContains? path "test_") true)
    ((stringContains? path "tests/acceptance/r1Host/reader/invalid/") true)
    ((stringContains? path "tests/acceptance/vtbotDataPlane/fixtures/invalid/") true)
    ((= path "agent/src/dispatch.asl") true)
    ((= path "agent/tests/dispatchTest.asl") true)
    ((= path "asl/packages/asl-macro/src/macro.asl") true)
    ((= path "asl/packages/asl-ui/src/main.asl") true)
    ((= path "mem/src/tasks.asl") true)
    ((= path "tests/acceptance/d81/Task58801IntermediatePolicyTest.asl") true)
    (else false))

fn parseFileList stdout: String -> (List String)
  (filter (fn [(p String)] -> Bool (not (stringEmpty? p))) (stringSplit stdout "\n"))

fn formsMatch? lForms: (List rd/SExpr) iForms: (List rd/SExpr) -> Bool
  (if (!= (listLength lForms) (listLength iForms))
    false
    (fold (fn [(m Bool) (p (Pair rd/SExpr rd/SExpr))] -> Bool
            (and m (= (rd/renderSexpr (pairFirst p)) (rd/renderSexpr (pairSecond p))))
          true (zip lForms iForms))))

(schema CorpusStats
  (:f matched Int64)
  (:f excluded Int64)
  (:f failed Int64))

fn verifyParsedFile path: String src: String iForms: (List rd/SExpr) -> CorpusStats
  (mt (lay/lowerString src)
    ((err e)
     (do
       (assert false (str path " layout lower failed: " e))
       (CorpusStats :matched 0 :excluded 0 :failed 1)))
    ((ok lForms)
     (let [(matched (formsMatch? lForms iForms))]
       (do
         (assert matched (str path " lowering matches a/parse renderSexpr"))
         (if matched
           (CorpusStats :matched 1 :excluded 0 :failed 0)
           (CorpusStats :matched 0 :excluded 0 :failed 1)))))))

fn verifyCorpusFile path: String -> CorpusStats
  (mt (fileRead path)
    ((err e)
     (do
       (assert false (str path " read error: " e))
       (CorpusStats :matched 0 :excluded 0 :failed 1)))
    ((ok src)
     (mt (ip/parseIndentedForms src)
       ((err e)
        (do
          (print (str "EXCLUDED " path ": reference parser rejects: " e "\n"))
          (CorpusStats :matched 0 :excluded 1 :failed 0)))
       ((ok iForms)
        (verifyParsedFile path src iForms)))))

fn addStats a: CorpusStats b: CorpusStats -> CorpusStats
  (CorpusStats :matched (+ a.matched     b.matched    )
               :excluded (+ a.excluded     b.excluded    )
               :failed (+ a.failed     b.failed    ))

fn shardFiles k: Int64 n: Int64 -> (List String)
  (let [(cmdRes (processRun "git ls-files '*.asl'"))
        (allFiles (parseFileList cmdRes.stdout    ))
        (kept (filter (fn [(p String)] -> Bool (not (isParenOrInvalidFile p))) allFiles))
        (sorted (listSort kept))
        (indexed (zip sorted (range 0 (listLength sorted))))]
    (map (fn [(p (Pair String Int64))] -> String (pairFirst p))
         (filter (fn [(p (Pair String Int64))] -> Bool (= (mod (pairSecond p) n) k)) indexed)))

fn runShard k: Int64 n: Int64 name: String -> Bool
  (let [(files (shardFiles k n))
        (t0 (monotonicNs))
        (init (CorpusStats :matched 0 :excluded 0 :failed 0))
        (stats (fold (fn [(acc CorpusStats) (path String)] -> CorpusStats
                      (addStats acc (verifyCorpusFile path)))
                    init files))
        (t1 (monotonicNs))
        (ms (/ (- t1 t0) 1000000))]
    (do
      (print (str name ": matched " (stringFromInt64 stats.matched    )
                   " excluded " (stringFromInt64 stats.excluded    )
                   " failed " (stringFromInt64 stats.failed    )
                   " of " (stringFromInt64 (listLength files)) " files in "
                   (stringFromInt64 ms) " ms\n"))
      (assert (= stats.failed     0) (str name ": all file assertions passed"))
      (assert (> (+ stats.matched     stats.excluded    ) 0) (str name ": shard checked at least one file"))
      true)))
